column1: Consolidated Chart of Accounts Mapping & Intercompany Guide
Tage Venture Capital (Parent) + Recruit 619 + Signent HR + Instant NDA | Multi-Entity Reporting Ready
Purpose: Common account numbers, IC Due To/From pairs, elimination rules for consolidated financials. Prevents double-counting.
1. Each entity books transactions to its own CoA using the numbers above.
2. Parent records Due From Sub + Management Fee Income / Shared Services Income.
3. Each Sub records Due To Parent + Management Fee Expense 6950 + shared OpEx.
4. At consolidation: Eliminate all IC Due To/From balances (should net to zero). Eliminate Mgmt Fee Income vs Expense. Eliminate Shared Services Income vs the corresponding expense portions on subs.
5. External revenue (placements, HR services, SaaS subs) and external costs remain.
6. This structure supports the existing financial model (shared services, 5% fee, 90% bank savings, contingency).
7. Future: Add dimensions or sub-accounts if more granularity needed (e.g. by department or project).
